    The prefix order on morphisms out of a point #

    For a point b of a ray category, BMor b collects the morphisms starting at b; ν ≤ μ (RayCat.BLe) means μ = ν ≫ ρ (Fischbacher's order on _bP). An infinite zigzag x₀ ≤ U₀ ≥ x₁ ≤ U₁ ≥ … of prefixes with consecutive lower and consecutive upper terms incomparable gives chains of every length (RayCat.not_chainBounded_of_zigzag); in a chain-bounded ray category such zigzags do not exist. Fischbacher's tree arguments reduce to this.
